prompt:
A real photograph, taken with a good phone camera and looking exactly like a phone photograph, of one German man of fifty, a hospital doctor on the night shift standing in a plain photographic studio, in a tall vertical picture, the whole person in view from the top of the head to the shoes, with a band of plain background above the head and below the feet, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, soft even daylight from the front left. The textures of real cotton, skin and hair, with the true depth and the slight lens perspective of a photograph.

The reference picture is a real phone photograph taken in the same hospital: use it for the photographic look only (the same true-to-life rendering, the same natural colours and fine detail, nothing drawn or painted). Its room and its people do not appear here.

THE BACKGROUND is a plain seamless light-grey studio wall that curves into a light-grey floor, with a soft shadow under the shoes. The picture carries no writing, numbers, print, symbol or logo anywhere: the clothes have no name badge, no embroidery and no brand.

HE is tall and broad, with fair skin, short greying brown hair, a neatly trimmed grey-brown beard, tired but alert grey eyes behind rimless glasses, and a calm, serious, reassuring expression. He wears a white doctor's coat, open, over light-blue hospital scrubs, white trainers; a black stethoscope hangs around his neck.

The person stands upright and relaxed, the body turned a little to the left of the picture and the face turned towards the camera, both arms relaxed at the sides, both hands empty and fully in view, the two feet flat on the floor a little apart. The expression is natural and friendly, caught as if the photographer had just said something kind; the eyes look just past the camera.
